key.description: Trello API key, sent as the 'key' query parameter on every request. Never log or print this value.

token.description: Trello API token, sent as the 'token' query parameter on every request. Never log or print this value.

base_url.description: Trello API base URL override for fixture replay, tests, or approved proxies.

id.description: Trello board id used by the lists and checklists streams; most other parameterized reads use direct-read command flags.

board_ids.description: Optional comma-separated Trello board IDs retained for compatibility with earlier Trello connector configurations.
